brief.summary: Oil is the dominant macro driver: crude rose above $90, diesel hit a record $5.88 and gasoline $4.14, while equities ended lower Friday. Strong August payrolls kept inflation concerns alive and reinforced expectations of a Fed hike this month, with market odds around 50-50; front-end yields rise and the long end is seen higher on heavy borrowing. Geopolitical escalation is rising after Iranian missile attacks and U.S. strikes on tankers, even as Kushner/Witkoff pursue Russia-Ukraine talks. AI and earnings tone is positive, but the consumer is strained by energy costs. Overall tone is risk-off.
